title: BuildIt Watch Configuration
description: Official JSON Schema configuration for BuildIt continuous development watcher (Watch).

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for autocomplete and validation in editors.

defineVersionString.description: Identifier of the constant for application version injection (default: '__APP_VERSION__').

versionPaths.description: List of files or directories where the synchronized version.ts should be ensured.

forcepackagesversion.description: If true, synchronizes the version across all workspace packages (deno.json / deno.jsonc).

targets.description: Dictionary of targets to continuously watch.

default.description: If true, watched automatically when no specific target is passed to CLI.

srcdir.description: Base source directory for watched target.

distdir.description: Destination directory where watched outputs are saved.

copyFiles.description: Sets of copy rules for static files to distdir.

includes.description: List of glob / brace expansion patterns to include.

excludes.description: List of glob / brace expansion patterns to exclude.

includes.description: Glob patterns relative to distdir to remove (use '*' for everything).

excludes.description: Glob patterns relative to distdir to preserve.

oneOf.description: List of paths to clean before the first build.

clean.description: Pre-build cleanup rules for output directory.

entryPoints.description: Entry files to watch (relative to srcdir).

bundle.description: Whether to bundle external dependencies and imports.

minify.description: Whether to apply minification (usually false during development).

sourcemap.description: Sourcemap strategy (inline is recommended in watch for fast rebuilds).

defineAssetsString.description: Identifier of the constant for injecting the list of generated assets (e.g., '__GENERATED_ASSETS__').

drop.description: Directives to eliminate calls from code.

write.description: Whether to write generated files to disk on each change.

analyze.description: Generates bundle analysis report in console after build (enables metafile automatically).

reserveProps.description: Regex for properties to preserve during mangling (e.g., '/^_.*/').

sideEffects.description: Informs esbuild whether code should be treated as having side effects for tree-shaking.

keepNames.description: Preserves original function and class names.

outfile.description: Output file path generated on each change.

inject.description: Files to inject into bundle header.

banner.description: Banner added to the top of generated files.

footer.description: Footer added to the bottom of generated files.

logLevel.description: Detail level for rebuild console logs.

globalName.description: Global variable name for exposing IIFE bundle.

tsconfig.description: Path to a custom TypeScript configuration file (tsconfig.json).

tsconfigRaw.description: Raw TypeScript configuration content (JSON string or object).

sourcesContent.description: Whether to include original source file content in sourcemaps.

ignoreAnnotations.description: Whether to ignore purity annotations such as /* @__PURE__ */ during minification.

minifyIdentifiers.description: Granular minification: rename identifiers to short names.

minifySyntax.description: Granular minification: rewrite syntax to more compact forms.

mangleQuoted.description: Whether to mangle quoted object properties.

mangleCache.description: Cache for persisting mangled names across builds.
